rules.description: Кодекс на труда чл. 155(4): basic paid annual leave not less than 20 working days

source.title: Кодекс на труда (Bulgarian Labour Code), чл. 154 и чл. 155

versions.notes: Чл. 155(4) (as amended ДВ 25/2001): "не по-малко от 20 работни дни"; чл. 155(2): on first employment the leave may be used after at least 4 months of service. Verified as the law in force on the verification date; historical effective date not researched, so effectiveFrom is set to 2026-01-01 (earlier dates resolve to the parent/none).

rules.description: National transposition status of the EU Pay Transparency Directive (EU) 2023/970

value.law: Existing acts notified (incl. Labour Code and Protection against Discrimination Act amendments 2026); main amendment of the Protection against Discrimination Act pending in the National Assembly

source.title: EUR-Lex: national transposition measures communicated for Directive (EU) 2023/970

versions.notes: EUR-Lex lists 12 Bulgarian measures (latest 2026-05-26). A law-firm report (cms.law, 14 Sep 2026) says the Council of Ministers submitted the main transposition bill to the National Assembly on 11 Sep 2026 — not verified on an official Bulgarian site; status "partially_transposed" reflects notified measures while the main bill is pending.
